cases.name: cache-invalidation/delete-keeps-lease
cases.description: Invalidating the cache does not cancel the outstanding fill lease, so a reader that missed before the write fills the old value afterwards.

cases.name: cache-invalidation/fill-ignores-lease
cases.description: The cache accepts a fill without comparing its lease to the current one.

cases.name: job-queue/ack-ignores-receipt

expected.match: was completed by an ack with stale receipt

cases.description: An ack completes a job by job id alone, so a worker whose delivery timed out completes the redelivered job.

cases.name: job-queue/effect-not-idempotent
cases.description: The worker applies a job's effect on every delivery instead of once per job.

cases.name: quorum-kv/read-takes-last-answer

expected.match: returned the initial value after write

cases.description: A quorum read returns the last replica answer instead of the newest version among the answers.

cases.name: quorum-kv/version-without-writer
cases.description: Writers leave their id out of the version, so two concurrent writes get the same version and replicas keep whichever arrived first.

cases.name: quorum-kv/replica-overwrites

expected.match: the newest it was offered is

cases.description: A replica stores every write it receives, also one older than what it holds.

cases.name: online-migration/copy-overwrites-newer
cases.description: The new store applies a backfill copy without comparing sequence numbers, so a copy of an old row replaces a newer dual write.

cases.name: online-migration/cutover-during-write
cases.description: Cutover waits for reads to drain but not for a write that has reached only the old store.

cases.name: offline-sync/retry-not-deduplicated
cases.description: The server does not remember applied requests, so a retry after a lost reply is treated as a new update.

cases.name: seat-hold/confirm-ignores-hold
cases.description: Confirm checks that the seat is held, not that it is held by the confirming hold, so an expired hold buys a seat held by someone else.

cases.name: order-cancel-vs-ship/refund-not-idempotent
cases.description: Payments settles an order on every request instead of once.

cases.name: paxos/value-from-last-promise
cases.description: A proposer adopts the accepted value of the last promise it receives instead of the one with the highest ballot.

cases.name: paxos/majority-off-by-one
cases.description: A proposer counts half of the acceptors as a majority.

cases.name: paxos/accept-ignores-promise
cases.description: An acceptor accepts a proposal with a ballot below the one it promised.

cases.name: raft/vote-without-log-check

expected.match: applied before does not match with

cases.description: A server grants its vote without checking that the candidate's log is as up to date as its own.

cases.name: raft/votes-twice-in-a-term
cases.description: A server grants a vote to every candidate of a term, not only the first.

cases.name: raft/commit-on-half

expected.match: applied before does not match with

cases.description: The leader commits an entry once half of the cluster holds it, not a majority.

cases.name: raft/commits-earlier-term

expected.match: applied before does not match with

cases.description: The leader commits an entry of an earlier term by counting replicas.

cases.name: raft/upstream-leader-completeness

expected.match: was committed before but not in the new leader

cases.description: The upstream tutorial as it is: with message loss a new leader misses a committed entry.

cases.name: two-phase-commit/upstream-read-mismatch

expected.match: Record read is not same as what was written

cases.description: The upstream tutorial as it is: a client reads a value other than the one its committed transaction wrote.
